comment: The phase offsets are written as std::sin(radianPhase - 120) and (radianPhase - 240) at TripLFO.cpp:100 and 105. Those constants are radians, not degrees, so the spacing is 120 and 240 radians reduced into a cycle: roughly a tenth and a fifth of a cycle rather than the third and two-thirds the panel prints. The polyphonic output writes channels i, i+1 and i+2 inside the per-channel loop (TripLFO.cpp:114-116) while declaring three channels, so with a polyphonic rate cable the channels overwrite each other; with a monophonic rate jack it is correct.
